The Big Beautiful Bill (H.R.1) redirects funding to sustainable solutions—price transparency, competition, and patient-first reforms—instead of perpetuating a cycle where taxpayers fund corporate profits. Renewing subsidies without structural change just kicks the can.

Cut the waste, break the monopolies, and let markets lower costs permanently.
